note: Generated by scripts/cube-reference/generate.py from the original 1D-Tic-Tac-Toe logic. Stickers: index = face*9 + row*3 + col, faces U,D,F,B,L,R. Values use the ORIGINAL convention: 1 = circle (O), 2 = cross (X); tests convert to this project's 1 = X, 2 = O.
dirConvention: dir +1 = +90 degrees right-hand rule about +axis (anticlockwise seen from the positive end), -1 = -90, 2 = 180. layer l turns the stickers whose coordinate on the axis is l-1.
